note: Bone rotations (degrees) matching the reference sheet pose: hands on hips, S-curve, the sheet's uneven stance. Rotations about the world axes through each bone head (R = Rz Ry Rx), applied in the parent frame; arms mirror .L to .R (y and z negate), legs are free per side. Found by rig_fit.fit_pose against the tail-free halves of identity-run-0001 (plus the lower legs below the tails); arms start from sheet-read directions and move at most 35 degrees; angles only, never lengths. rootShift is [dx, dy] in model units; the ground drop is recomputed per model.
